card.name: NetBSD mount commands and device names
card.fires_on: Parts of Unix shell commands for mounting disks, such as mount, device paths like /dev/cd0a, and sysctl or vnconfig, in a NetBSD guide about CDs and floppies.

modes.label: Mount command words
modes.description: The command name mount or its pieces and flags in a mount line.

modes.label: Device name parts
modes.description: Pieces of device paths such as /dev or the trailing letter in cd0a.
modes.example: mount -t cd9660 /dev/cd0<<a>> /mnt This command shouldn't print

modes.label: Other admin commands
modes.description: Partway through tools like sysctl and vnconfig in the same guide.
